randomize_domain_dynamics: randomize domain dynamics of a MuJoCo model with friction, mass, and joint perturbations
randomize_friction_parameters: randomize floor and foot friction parameters uniformly between 0.4 and 1.0
randomize_dof_frictionloss: randomize dof frictionloss by scaling with uniform factor between 0.5 and 2.0
randomize_body_masses: randomize all body masses by scaling and add uniform torso mass perturbation
randomize_initial_positions: randomize initial joint positions with uniform jitter between -0.05 and 0.05
